answer: Start with the precondition. Reputation only means something if it expires. Standing decays every epoch an identity does not work, and it resets to zero the moment an account tries to link itself to another, so a vertex of shared wallets cannot pool history. Each claim is re-checked by an agent that gains nothing from passing it. A parked pile of identities reaches the comet with no standing at all, and rebuilding one costs the same copper as earning it fresh.
